land_tenure.evidence: Ch313 application Improvements Map (Tab 11) explicitly labels a 'Leased land border' around the project boundary; Tab 9 'Description of Land' answered 'Not Applicable'; Coleman CAD owner-name search for Hanson Solar / Hanson / Cypress Creek / Cypress Creek Renewables returned 0 parcel records in all 4 cases, consistent with parcels remaining on the tax roll under original (unidentified) landowner names

evidence: Sentinel-2 wide-frame chip (imagery/s2_2026-07-10_xwide.png) reveals a ~3,000-acre graded/cleared polygon matching the exact shape of Cypress Creek's own Ch313 Improvements Map boundary

Monthly timelapse (imagery/s2_2024-07-01.png through s2_2026-07-01.png, plus dekad frames to 2026-07-11): site undisturbed through 2025-03-01; a bright graded substation pad appears exactly at the mapped substation location by 2025-04-01 (tight bracket, absent 03-01/present 04-01)
Grading/clearing expands to ~2/3 of the polygon by 2025-06-01 and to essentially the full footprint by 2025-09-01

Darker, more uniform rectangular patches consistent with possible racking/panel installation appear from 2026-03-01 onward, but 10m Sentinel-2 resolution cannot confirm this over bare graded soil - no unambiguous full-field panel signature observed through 2026-07-11

Graded footprint extent is stable across the most recent 6 weeks of frames (2026-06-11 to 2026-07-11), consistent with the site having moved from bulk earthwork into an equipment/electrical-installation phase

reasoning_evidence: The reported COD (2027-04-17) is not merely a developer claim: it is the exact Scheduled Commercial Operation Date in Amendment No. 1 to the signed Oncor-Hanson Solar interconnection agreement (PUCT Control No. 35077, filed 2024-08-15) - this confirms the date is contractually grounded, but because the queue's projectCod and the IA schedule likely share a common source, this is NOT independent evidence the date is achievable, only that it is real and not fabricated

The schedule already slipped once, by about 18 months, between the original IA (2023-09-20, Scheduled COD 2025-10-21) and Amendment No. 1 (2024, Scheduled COD 2027-04-17) - this occurred before construction began, showing the project is not immune to schedule risk

Independent imagery evidence shows construction progressing broadly in step with the amended schedule: site-wide grading essentially complete by ~2025-09, stable extensive graded footprint through mid-2026, with the contractual In-Service Date (2026-12-03) about 5 months out from the latest clear imagery (2026-07-11)

As of the latest imagery, panel/racking installation could not be confirmed (resolution limit), leaving the final construction stage unverified with only ~5 months of schedule buffer to the In-Service Date

Countervailing positive signals: financing closed Nov 2025, EPC (TIC/Kiewit) engaged and construction mobilized, Meta offtake signed, letters of credit posted and increasing per schedule, 3 years of Ch313 Form 772 annual compliance reports filed - all consistent with an active, funded, monitored real project rather than one at elevated risk of cancellation or major delay

contractual_schedule.note: Oncor-Hanson Solar interconnection agreement (PUCT Control No. 35077); Amendment No. 1 filed 2024-08-15. Letters of credit posted with Oncor: $11.3M eff. Nov 2023 rising to $13.4M by Dec 2025.
